title.en: Seeing Off Vice-Prefect Du to His Post in Shu

year_display.zh: 约 7 世纪 60 年代末

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems); the variant readings it marks are left out.
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本），删去其所注异文。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 676.

note.en: Wang Bo was still very young when he wrote this, and it is the poem most readers know him by. Farewell poems usually end in tears; this one forbids them, on the grounds that a true friend anywhere makes distance small. Its third couplet is still written in letters to people who are far away.
note.zh: 王勃写这首诗时还很年轻，它也是大多数读者认识王勃的那首诗。送别诗大多以泪水收尾，这首却不许流泪，理由是：只要世上有知己，再远也像近邻。“海内存知己，天涯若比邻”至今还常被写进寄给远方的信里。

excerpt.orig: 海內存知己，天涯若比隣。
excerpt.en: Within the four seas, if you have one who knows you, / the ends of the sky are like next door.
excerpt.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
